items.title: Bring your newsletter subscribers
items.detail: Sign-up forms came across, and new sign-ups are kept for you in OpenSpace. Your old site didn't keep a subscriber list itself: if its form sent sign-ups to an email service (like Mailchimp or Buttondown), download the list there and add it in Inbox → Subscribers → Import.

items.title: Use boulderfeetforward.org for your new site
items.detail: Your new site is live on a free address. When you're happy with it, we'll help you point boulderfeetforward.org at it — your old site keeps working until then.

items.title: Use your own font licence
items.detail: Your old site used Newsreader Variable, which we're not allowed to copy, so the closest free font stands in (Playfair Display). If you have a web licence, download the font files (WOFF2) from the font service and upload them in Site Styles → Your fonts — they're stored in media/fonts/ — then choose them for your headings and text.
